factProposals.value: Residents use a public portal to submit code enforcement permit applications and schedule inspections.
Residents reach their application with a private link, not an account.
A submitted application gets a confirmation notification, and a scheduled inspection date is shown on the portal.

decisions.statement: Residents use a private link instead of accounts.
decisions.rationale: no sign-up step for residents; accounts can be added later

decisions.statement: A repeated submission with the same submission key returns the existing application.
decisions.rationale: a retry must not create a duplicate application

limitations.statement: Email is SIMULATED: no mail service is connected, so confirmations are shown on the portal and nothing is sent.
Only code enforcement permits are offered.
